messages:
Lex (Growth): Quick sync — our 12pm webinar "Scaling Redwood Inference" has ~1.2k registrants. Ops just flagged a degradation in the streaming API (affecting streaming responses) starting ~10m ago. Need marketing guidance on status page wording, attendee comms, and whether to delay or run the webinar with a script.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks — priority is customer trust. Two things: 1) immediate short status page entry so public customers see we're aware, 2) a targeted email to registrants within 20 minutes if the webinar will be affected. We should avoid technical root-cause speculation in the initial messaging.

Marco (CS): If streaming is flaky some demo flows will break. We can switch demos to pre-recorded clips, but attendees need to know if interactive Q&A might be impacted. CS recommends notifying registrants with a short note and offering a follow-up live Q&A if needed.

Tori (Ops): Incident is INC-20021. We're rolling back a streaming infra change; rollback in progress. Current ETA to restore streaming: ~30 minutes. I'll post updates.

Priya (Marketing): Draft short public status page copy (candidate):

Priya (Marketing): ```
Short status: We are investigating degraded streaming responses for the Streaming API in us-east-1. Engineers are working on a rollback. Some streaming requests may experience delays or incomplete chunks. We will post updates here every 15 minutes.

Note to customers: If your application relies on streaming, consider switching to non-streaming endpoints temporarily. Contact support for help.
```

Lex (Growth): For registrants: recommend a brief email subject + body that is action-oriented. Suggested subject: "Webinar update: potential streaming issues — quick note". Body should say: the webinar will proceed, demos may be pre-recorded, Q&A may be delayed; provide link to open a support ticket and option to schedule a 1:1 demo post-webinar.

Priya (Marketing): Draft registrant email copy (candidate):

Priya (Marketing): ```
Subject: Webinar update — potential demo impact

Hello — quick update: Our scheduled webinar "Scaling Redwood Inference" will proceed as planned at 12pm PT. We are currently investigating an issue affecting streaming responses that may impact live demos. We will run with pre-recorded demos if necessary and still host the Q&A; if your team needs a guaranteed live demo, reply to this email and we'll schedule a 1:1.

We apologize for any inconvenience — latest status: https://status.redwood.ai

Thanks,
The Redwood Team
```

Marco (CS): That works. Add CSM contact block for customers on Dedicated. Also include note that registrants can opt-in to a follow-up live Q&A session.

Tori (Ops): IncidentBot: [Incident update] 1854321275  Mitigation: rollback started. Est. recovery 25m.

Priya (Marketing): Social/AMP copy — short tweet: "We're investigating streaming interruptions for the Redwood Streaming API in us-east-1. Engineers on it; updates: https://status.redwood.ai" Keep it factual and link to status only.

Lex (Growth): Timing decision: publish public status now, send registrant email in 10 minutes if rollback not confirmed. If rollback confirms within 10m, we send a short reassurance email instead.

Tori (Ops): Will update here in 10m or when rollback completes. INC-20021 now tracking.

IncidentBot: [Incident update] 1854321380  Rolling back streaming change; progress 60%. Est. recovery 12m.

Priya (Marketing): OK locking the messages. Final short status page line (ready to publish): "We are investigating degraded streaming responses for the Streaming API in us-east-1. Engineers have initiated a rollback of a recent change. Some streaming requests may be delayed or incomplete. Updates will be posted here every 15 minutes."

Marco (CS): I'll prepare a short host script to pivot demos to pre-recorded and a slide to explain the situation to attendees.

Tori (Ops): Rollback complete at 1854321398. Streaming confirmed healthy at 1854321402, monitoring. Closing INC-20021 if stable for 10m.

Lex (Growth): Great — Priya, publish the status page and hold the registrant email; send the reassurance email now saying the webinar will proceed with live demos restored. Jordan and CS will be on standby for Q&A.

Priya (Marketing): Sent reassurance email to registrants at 1854321405: "Issue resolved — webinar proceeding with live demos restored. See status: https://status.redwood.ai"

Lex (Growth): Thanks everyone. Follow-up: post-incident blog + short recap to webinar attendees and a recorded replay with timestamps for the Q&A. We'll include a short note about what we learned and how we'll prevent recurrence.
